gaps.limit:hooks_max_firings: no cheap hook pack drives 10000 firings; needs a dedicated amplification pack
gaps.limit:hooks_max_rounds: needs a hook pack whose firings feed each other for >64 rounds
gaps.limit:hooks_max_state_quads: needs a hook pack deriving >1M quads (heavy)
gaps.limit:max_outstanding_alloc_bytes: wasm allocator bound; not reachable from a request under the 16 MiB frame cap without guest-side instrumentation
gaps.limit:n3_max_backward_depth: needs a recursive backward-chaining N3 program deeper than 32
gaps.limit:n3_max_backward_solutions_per_goal: needs a goal with >1024 backward solutions
gaps.limit:n3_max_derived_facts: needs an N3 program deriving >500000 facts (heavy)
gaps.limit:n3_max_match_steps: needs >200000 match steps in one rule (heavy)
gaps.limit:n3_max_total_bytes: 268435456 B exceeds the 16 MiB request cap; unreachable through the ABI
